text-shadow.title: text-shadow
text-shadow.history: Adds shadow to text for emphasis or depth. Accepts x/y offsets, blur radius, and color.
text-shadow.tip: You can use values like 2px 2px 5px gray to specify the text shadow.
text-shadow.code: Shadowed Heading
text-shadow.quiz: Which property adds a shadow behind text?

border-radius.title: border-radius
border-radius.history: Rounds element corners. Can be uniform or per-corner. Works on most replaced elements and boxes.
border-radius.tip: The border-radius property only affects the rounding of the corners of the border of an element. It does not include padding or margin.

filter.title: filter
filter.history: Applies graphical effects like blur, brightness, contrast, grayscale to elements (commonly images). Can be chained.
filter.quiz: Which property applies blur, brightness, and contrast effects?

transform.title: transform
transform.history: Performs 2D/3D transforms like rotate, scale, skew, translate. Often combined with transition for smooth animations.
transform.quiz: Which property rotates, scales, skews, or translates elements?

transition.title: transition
transition.history: Creates smooth changes between states for animatable properties. Use with :hover, :focus, or JS-driven class changes.
transition.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>transition</title>
<style>
  .btn { background:#4f46e5; color:white; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:8px; transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease; }
  .btn:hover { background:#3730a3; transform: translateY(-3px); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="btn">Hover me</button>
</body>
</html>
transition.quiz: Which property enables smooth changes between states?

mix-blend-mode.title: mix-blend-mode
mix-blend-mode.history: Blends an element with the backdrop using blend modes (multiply, screen, overlay) similar to image editors.
mix-blend-mode.quiz: Which property blends an element with its background using Photoshop-like modes?

background-blend-mode.title: background-blend-mode
background-blend-mode.history: Blends multiple background layers (images, gradients, colors) of the same element.
background-blend-mode.tip: Use 'multiply' to create a darker effect where layers overlap.
background-blend-mode.quiz: Which property blends multiple backgrounds of one element?

clip-path.title: clip-path
clip-path.history: Cuts an element into custom shapes using basic shapes or SVG paths. Great for creative layouts and masks.
clip-path.tip: Creates custom geometric masks like polygons or circles; elements outside the specific path become completely invisible and unclickable.
clip-path.quiz: Which property cuts an element into custom shapes?

mask-image.title: mask-image / mask-clip
mask-image.history: Use images or gradients as masks to control element visibility. More flexible than clip-path for soft edges.
mask-image.quiz: Which properties apply an image or gradient as a mask?

perspective.title: perspective Property
perspective.history: The CSS `perspective` property defines the distance between the z=0 plane and the user in order to give a 3D-positioned element some perspective. It affects how 3D transformed children are rendered, creating depth.
perspective.code: Perspective demo
perspective.quiz: Which property sets the distance used to create a 3D perspective for transformed children?

backdrop-filter.title: backdrop-filter Property
backdrop-filter.history: Applies graphical effects (blur, brightness, contrast, etc.) to the area behind an element. Useful for frosted‑glass UIs and subtle background treatments.
backdrop-filter.code:
Frosted panel

This uses backdrop-filter to blur and saturate the background behind the panel.
backdrop-filter.quiz: Which property applies graphical effects to the area behind an element (requires transparency)?

preserve-3d.title: perspective & transform-style: preserve-3d
preserve-3d.history: Perspective gives 3D depth; transform-style: preserve-3d allows nested 3D transforms to keep their 3D context.
preserve-3d.code: 3D Card
preserve-3d.quiz: Which properties enable 3D depth and nested 3D transforms?

will-change.title: will-change
will-change.history: Hints the browser about upcoming changes (transform, opacity) to optimize rendering. Use sparingly to avoid memory overhead.
will-change.tip: Use will-change to hint the browser about upcoming changes and optimize performance.
will-change.quiz: Which property hints the browser for performance optimization?

drop-shadow.title: filter: drop-shadow()
drop-shadow.history: Creates shadows that follow the opaque parts of an element (better for non-rectangular shapes) and can look more natural than box-shadow.
drop-shadow.quiz: Which filter produces natural shadows following an element's opaque shape?

shape-outside.title: shape-outside
shape-outside.history: Defines a float shape so inline content wraps around custom shapes (circle, polygon, path). Useful for magazine-style layouts.
shape-outside.code: Long paragraph text wraps around the circular float using shape-outside.
shape-outside.quiz: Which property wraps text around custom float shapes?

object-fit.title: object-fit / object-position
object-fit.history: Control how replaced elements (images, videos) fit inside their containers and where they are positioned (cover, contain, center, top).
object-fit.quiz: Which properties control image fitting and positioning inside a container?

scroll-snap.title: scroll-snap
scroll-snap.history: Enables smooth snapping behavior for scroll containers — ideal for carousels, slides, and paginated UIs.
scroll-snap.tip: The scroll-snap property enables snapping behavior for scrollable carousels.
scroll-snap.code:
1
2
3
scroll-snap.quiz: Which feature enables snapping behavior for carousels and sliders?

pointer-events.title: pointer-events
pointer-events.history: Controls whether an element reacts to pointer (mouse/touch) events. Useful to disable clicks or let events pass through.
pointer-events.tip: The pointer-events property controls mouse/touch interactions on an element.
pointer-events.quiz: Which property controls whether an element receives pointer events?

isolation.title: isolation
isolation.history: Creates a new stacking context so blend modes and z-index behave predictably; useful when using mix-blend-mode or complex stacking.
isolation.tip: The isolation property creates a new stacking context for blend modes.
isolation.quiz: Which property creates a new stacking context for blend modes?

houdini.title: CSS Houdini Paint API
houdini.history: Allows custom drawing via JavaScript paint worklets so you can create procedural backgrounds and effects directly in CSS.
houdini.code: Custom paint worklet background
houdini.quiz: Which API lets you draw custom backgrounds programmatically in CSS?

anchor-positioning.title: CSS Anchor Positioning (experimental)
anchor-positioning.history: Positions elements relative to another element (anchor) for tooltips/popovers. Syntax and support are evolving.
anchor-positioning.tip: The anchor-name and position-anchor properties enable precise element positioning.
anchor-positioning.code: Tooltip/popover positioned relative to anchor
anchor-positioning.quiz: Which experimental feature positions elements relative to another element?

scroll-animations.title: Scroll-driven animations
scroll-animations.history: Animate properties based on scroll progress (scroll timelines). Enables immersive, scroll-linked motion. Support is growing.
scroll-animations.code: Scroll to animate
scroll-animations.quiz: Which technique animates elements based on scroll progress?

motion-path.title: CSS Motion Path (offset-path)
motion-path.history: Animate elements along custom paths using offset-path, offset-distance, and related properties. Great for complex motion effects.
motion-path.tip: The offset-path, offset-distance, and offset-rotate properties animate elements along custom paths.
motion-path.quiz: Which CSS feature animates elements along custom paths?

css-color-14.title: CSS Color Level 4/5
css-color-14.history: New color spaces (Lab, LCH, HWB) and improved color functions for more accurate and perceptual color control in design systems.
css-color-14.quiz: Which new color specs provide perceptual color control like LCH and HWB?
